title: spiraea insularis
intro: Spiraea insularis, commonly known as the Islay spiraea, is a flowering plant species within the rose family. It is known to possess various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect the body against free radicals and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Spiraea insularis include its use in treating digestive issues and as a natural remedy for colds and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
